questions.question: OP-01's record has 22 open items for a reopen session (O14 to O44, from audit-025 and this review), but /observe has no mode for deciding open items. How should the reopen run?

options.label: File BK-501 first (Recommended)
options.description: A small tooling PR adds a reopen mode to /observe: one dialog per open item, the answer recorded as a new decision D45+ naming what it amends, then /observe-review again. The reopen session follows in a fresh session.

options.label: Reopen ad hoc now
options.description: Run a fresh armed /observe OP-01 and walk the open items by hand under the existing rules. Faster, but nothing defines the steps, so the session invents them, the failure mode RFC-0028 was written to close.

options.label: Spec first, reopen later
options.description: Write step 5's spec from the decisions no open item names, and leave the reopened clauses out until a later session. Against RFC-0028 P3 for the affected clauses; the spec is partial.

questions.question: OP-01's record has 22 open items for a reopen session (O14 to O44, from audit-025 and this review), but /observe has no mode for deciding open items. How should the reopen run?
BK-501 (an /observe reopen mode that decides a record's open items) is filed on branch bk-501-observe-reopen. What should this branch deliver?

options.label: Implement it here (Recommended)
options.description: I orient on BK-501 now: read the /observe skill, its hook (observe_ground.py, test_observe_ground.py) and RFC-0028. Then I ask its open decisions (how the mode arms, how an answer amends and closes its item, whether /observe-review reruns) and build the mode, tests and trace in this PR. The reopen session on OP-01 then runs in a fresh session.

options.label: Filing-only PR now
options.description: Open a PR with just the BK-501 entry and the decision log, with no trace (nothing is implemented yet). The implementation follows later in its own session and PR.

options.label: Stop here
options.description: Leave the branch pushed and unopened. You decide later when to take up BK-501.
